# Sluz

> Sluz is a minimalistic, zero-dependency, single-file PHP templating engine with
> Smarty-like syntax. It separates logic (.php files) from presentation (.stpl
> templates). Requires PHP 8.0 or newer.

The engine is the single file `sluz.class.php`. Templates use `{...}` delimiters
(customizable) for variables, modifiers, `{if}`, `{foreach}`, `{include}`,
`{literal}`, and comments. Parent/child templates, simple mode, inline mode, and
auto-escaping are supported.

## Documentation

- [Basic Vars](https://www.sluz.org/docs/?doc=001_basic_vars): Assigning scalars,
  arrays, and hashes to templates with `assign()`
- [Default Values](https://www.sluz.org/docs/?doc=002_default_values): Default values
  for variables that are null, empty, or unassigned
- [Basic If](https://www.sluz.org/docs/?doc=010_basic_if): `if` / `else` conditionals;
  unassigned variables evaluate as false
- [Basic Foreach](https://www.sluz.org/docs/?doc=030_basic_foreach): Looping over
  arrays and hashes
- [Advanced Foreach](https://www.sluz.org/docs/?doc=031_advanced_foreach): The
  `$__FOREACH_FIRST`, `$__FOREACH_LAST`, and `$__FOREACH_INDEX` loop variables
- [Literal Blocks](https://www.sluz.org/docs/?doc=040_literal_blocks): Using `{literal}`
  to output literal braces, for example in CSS and JavaScript
- [Include](https://www.sluz.org/docs/?doc=045_include): Including external templates
  with `{include}`, with paths relative to the calling PHP script
- [External Functions](https://www.sluz.org/docs/?doc=046_external_functions): Calling
  global or user PHP functions from templates
- [Alternate Templates](https://www.sluz.org/docs/?doc=047_alternate_templates):
  Choosing a different template file in `fetch()`
- [Simple Mode](https://www.sluz.org/docs/?doc=050_simple_mode): Function-oriented
  syntax using the global `sluz()` helper
- [Inline Mode](https://www.sluz.org/docs/?doc=060_inline_mode): Storing templates
  inside the PHP file after `__halt_compiler()`
- [Inline Simple Mode](https://www.sluz.org/docs/?doc=065_inline_simple_mode): Combining
  inline and simple mode in one file
- [Parent Child](https://www.sluz.org/docs/?doc=070_parent_child): Parent layouts with
  `$__CHILD_TPL` for shared headers and footers
- [Escape](https://www.sluz.org/docs/?doc=080_escape): The `escape` modifier with
  `html`, `url`, and `js` types
- [Autoescape](https://www.sluz.org/docs/?doc=085_autoescape): Automatic HTML-encoding
  of `{$var}` output, with `|raw` to opt out

## Engine and Source

- [sluz.class.php](https://www.sluz.org/latest/sluz.class.php): Current single-file
  engine, for direct download
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/scottchiefbaker/sluz): Source code, issues,
  and releases
- [Packagist package](https://packagist.org/packages/sluz/sluz): Composer package
  `sluz/sluz`
- [Release notes](https://github.com/scottchiefbaker/sluz/releases): Changes by version

## Optional

- [Project site](https://sluz.org/): Overview and quick start
- [Ports](https://github.com/scottchiefbaker/js-Template-Sluz): JavaScript port
  (`js-Template-Sluz`)
- [Perl port](https://github.com/scottchiefbaker/perl-Template-Sluz): Perl port
  (`perl-Template-Sluz`)
